tracks.purpose: Main menu and gameplay background music for the business tycoon sandbox game
tracks.prompt: Lo-fi classical fusion, modern financial broker game soundtrack, smooth piano melodies, subtle cello undercurrents, light pizzicato strings, slow steady downbeat, sophisticated, professional, calm focus, premium background music, loopable, no vocals, no songs, no lyrics
tracks.style: lo-fi classical fusion / financial broker game soundtrack
tracks.loop_processing: Playback with a 2.5 s pause between repeats, implemented in music.gd via AudioStreamPlayer.finished -> one-shot Timer -> _play(). The track has natural fade-in (0..1.75 s) and fade-out (21..23.94 s), so the restart joint is not abrupt. File level reduced by 3 dB (peak 0.622, RMS 0.068); the game plays it at -9 dB.
